sloka: प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तम् बुद्धिमान् वाक्य कोविदः ।चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य ग्रामम् वा यदि वा पुरम् ॥४-२६-९॥
transliteration: pratyuvāca hanūmantam buddhimān vākya kovidaḥ ।caturdaśa samāḥ saumya grāmam vā yadi vā puram ॥4-26-9॥

translations.english: 'Dear Hanuman In obedience to my father's command I should not enter any village or city for fourteen years.
